'''Eskol Folstock''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] underworld trader present on [[Makeb]] who worked alongside the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the citizens of Makeb during the stage of the [[Galactic War]] known as the [[Conquest of Makeb]] against the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].
